definition_en: Not yet having made a decision about something.
example_en: I'm still undecided about which university to choose.
example_uz: Men hali qaysi universitetni tanlash haqida qat'iy qaror qilmadim.

definition_en: Unable to make decisions quickly and confidently.
example_en: He is too indecisive to choose a restaurant for dinner.
example_uz: U kechki ovqat uchun restoran tanlashda juda ikkilanadi.

definition_en: The state of feeling sad or not satisfied.
example_en: Losing his job caused a lot of unhappiness in the family.
example_uz: Ishdan haydalishi oilada katta baxtsizlikka sabab bo'ldi.

definition_en: Made very angry by something.
example_en: The angered customer demanded to speak to the manager.
example_uz: G'azablangan mijoz menejer bilan gaplashishni talab qildi.

definition_en: In an angry way.
example_en: She slammed the door angrily and walked away.
example_uz: U g'azab bilan eshikni qarsillatib yopib ketib qoldi.

definition_en: Made to feel sad by something.
example_en: We were saddened to hear about the accident.
example_uz: Baxtsiz hodisa haqida eshitib xafa bo'ldik.

definition_en: Failing to meet expectations and causing sadness.
example_en: The film's ending was quite disappointing.
example_uz: Filmning oxiri juda ko'ngilsiz edi.

definition_en: Not pleased or satisfied with something.
example_en: Many customers are dissatisfied with the new policy.
example_uz: Ko'p mijozlar yangi qoida bilan norozi.

definition_en: A feeling of not being pleased or satisfied.
example_en: There is growing dissatisfaction among the staff.
example_uz: Xodimlar orasida noroziyat kuchayib bormoqda.

definition_en: Causing feelings of annoyance because of being unable to change something.
example_en: It's frustrating when the internet keeps disconnecting.
example_uz: Internet doim uzilib qolishi asabiylashtiradi.

definition_en: Not interesting or exciting.
example_en: The meeting was long and unexciting.
example_uz: Yig'ilish uzun va zerikarli edi.

definition_en: A feeling of shame or shyness in front of others.
example_en: He turned red with embarrassment after tripping in class.
example_uz: U sinfda qoqilib tushgach, noqulaylikdan qizarib ketdi.

definition_en: Not feeling ashamed or shy about something.
example_en: She stayed calm and unembarrassed despite the mistake.
example_uz: U xatosiga qaramay xotirjam va uyalmasdan qoldi.

definition_en: Not kind; unfriendly or slightly cruel.
example_en: It was unkind of him to laugh at her mistake.
example_uz: Uning xatosiga kulishi beshafqatlik edi.

definition_en: Unpleasant or unfriendly in manner.
example_en: He can be quite disagreeable when he's tired.
example_uz: U charchaganida ancha noxush bo'lib qolishi mumkin.

definition_en: Pleasant and easy to deal with.
example_en: She has a warm, agreeable personality.
example_uz: Uning iliq, yoqimli tabiati bor.

definition_en: Likely to argue and disagree with people.
example_en: He gets argumentative whenever politics comes up.
example_uz: Siyosat mavzusi chiqsa, u bahslashuvchan bo'lib qoladi.

definition_en: Quick to notice things; paying close attention.
example_en: An observant student noticed the error in the textbook.
example_uz: Ziyrak talaba darslikdagi xatoni payqadi.

definition_en: Able to be seen or noticed.
example_en: There was an observable change in his mood.
example_uz: Uning kayfiyatida kuzatiladigan o'zgarish bor edi.

definition_en: Able to be recognized or identified.
example_en: The suspect was easily identifiable from the video.
example_uz: Gumon qilinuvchi videodan osongina aniqlandi.

definition_en: Not recognized or named; unknown.
example_en: An unidentified man was seen near the building.
example_uz: Bino yaqinida noma'lum erkak ko'rilgan.

definition_en: Having or showing a creative imagination.
example_en: Children need imaginative play to develop their minds.
example_uz: Bolalarga aqlini rivojlantirish uchun ijodkor o'yinlar kerak.

definition_en: Lacking creativity or original ideas.
example_en: The design was safe but unimaginative.
example_uz: Dizayn xavfsiz, ammo ijodsiz edi.

definition_en: Lacking originality or new ideas.
example_en: The advertisement felt repetitive and uncreative.
example_uz: Reklama takrorlanuvchan va ijodiy bo'lmagandek tuyuldi.

definition_en: Describing something in detail.
example_en: The essay uses descriptive language to paint a picture.
example_uz: Insho manzarani tasvirlash uchun tasviriy til ishlatadi.

definition_en: Too extreme or unusual to be described in words.
example_en: The view from the mountain top was indescribable.
example_uz: Tog' cho'qqisidan ko'rinish ta'riflab bo'lmaydigan darajada edi.

definition_en: Serving to explain something.
example_en: The teacher added an explanatory note to the diagram.
example_uz: O'qituvchi diagrammaga tushuntiruvchi izoh qo'shdi.

definition_en: Impossible to explain or understand.
example_en: For some inexplicable reason, the door was locked.
example_uz: Qandaydir tushuntirib bo'lmaydigan sababga ko'ra eshik qulflangan edi.

definition_en: Not made clear or given a reason for.
example_en: The company gave an unexplained excuse for the delay.
example_uz: Kompaniya kechikish uchun tushuntirilmagan bahona keltirdi.

definition_en: So good or great that nothing else can be compared to it.
example_en: The chef's skill is simply incomparable.
example_uz: Oshpazning mahorati shunchaki tengsiz.

definition_en: Having a good and acceptable reason.
example_en: Her anger was completely justified after the delay.
example_uz: Kechikishdan keyin uning g'azabi to'liq asoslangan edi.

definition_en: Not having a good or fair reason.
example_en: The price increase seems completely unjustified.
example_uz: Narx oshishi butunlay asossiz ko'rinadi.

definition_en: Able to be shown to be right or reasonable.
example_en: His absence was justifiable given the emergency.
example_uz: Uning yo'qligi favqulodda vaziyatni hisobga olganda oqlash mumkin edi.

definition_en: Impossible to defend or excuse.
example_en: Such cruelty to animals is unjustifiable.
example_uz: Hayvonlarga bunday shafqatsizlik oqlab bo'lmaydi.

definition_en: A good reason for doing something.
example_en: He gave no justification for his sudden decision.
example_uz: U to'satdan qabul qilgan qarori uchun hech qanday oqlash keltirmadi.

definition_en: Behaving or happening in a way that is expected.
example_en: The plot of the movie was quite predictable.
example_uz: Filmning syujeti ancha bashorat qilinadigan edi.

definition_en: Not able to be known in advance; changeable.
example_en: Mountain weather can be very unpredictable.
example_uz: Tog' ob-havosi juda bashorat qilib bo'lmaydigan bo'lishi mumkin.

definition_en: Something that shows what is likely to happen.
example_en: Past behavior is often a predictor of future actions.
example_uz: O'tmishdagi xatti-harakat ko'pincha kelajakdagi harakatlarning bashoratchisidir.

definition_en: Able to be stopped from happening.
example_en: Most car accidents are preventable with careful driving.
example_uz: Ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydash orqali ko'pchilik avtohalokatlarning oldini olish mumkin.

definition_en: Done to stop something bad from happening.
example_en: Regular checkups are an important preventive measure.
example_uz: Muntazam tekshiruvlar muhim profilaktik chora hisoblanadi.

definition_en: To react to something with more emotion than is necessary.
example_en: Try not to overreact when you hear the news.
example_uz: Xabarni eshitganingizda haddan tashqari reaksiya bildirmaslikka harakat qiling.

definition_en: Having more skills or experience than a job requires.
example_en: She was rejected for being overqualified for the role.
example_uz: U lavozim uchun ortiqcha malakali bo'lgani sababli rad etildi.

definition_en: Not having the necessary skills or qualifications.
example_en: He felt unqualified for such a senior position.
example_uz: U bunday yuqori lavozim uchun o'zini malakasiz his qildi.

definition_en: To officially prevent someone from taking part because they broke a rule.
example_en: The runner was disqualified for a false start.
example_uz: Yugurchi noto'g'ri start olgani uchun musobaqadan chetlashtirildi.

definition_en: A person who is successful because of hard work and ability.
example_en: She has always been a high achiever at school.
example_uz: U maktabda doim yuqori natijalarga erishuvchi bo'lgan.

definition_en: Able to be achieved or accomplished.
example_en: Set achievable goals so you don't lose motivation.
example_uz: Motivatsiyangizni yo'qotmaslik uchun erishish mumkin bo'lgan maqsadlar qo'ying.

definition_en: Impossible to achieve or accomplish.
example_en: The deadline made the project feel unachievable.
example_uz: Muddat loyihani erishib bo'lmaydigandek his qildi.

definition_en: Not achieving the desired result.
example_en: His first attempt at the exam was unsuccessful.
example_uz: Uning imtihonga birinchi urinishi muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ldi.

definition_en: Not producing much or achieving good results.
example_en: The meeting was long and unproductive.
example_uz: Yig'ilish uzun va samarasiz edi.

definition_en: Not protected or kept safe from harm.
example_en: Never leave a young child unprotected near water.
example_uz: Yosh bolani suv yaqinida hech qachon himoyasiz qoldirmang.

definition_en: A person or thing that protects someone or something.
example_en: A screen protector keeps your phone safe from scratches.
example_uz: Ekran himoyachisi telefoningizni chizilishdan saqlaydi.

definition_en: To protect someone too much, limiting their freedom.
example_en: Parents shouldn't overprotect their children from every risk.
example_uz: Ota-onalar farzandlarini har bir xavfdan haddan tashqari himoya qilmasligi kerak.

definition_en: Responding to events rather than acting first.
example_en: The team was too reactive instead of planning ahead.
example_uz: Jamoa oldindan reja qilish o'rniga juda reaktiv edi.

definition_en: To make something exist again or produce a copy of it.
example_en: The museum tried to recreate a nineteenth-century street.
example_uz: Muzey o'n to'qqizinchi asr ko'chasini qayta yaratishga harakat qildi.

definition_en: To develop or build something again, usually differently.
example_en: The city plans to redevelop the old harbor area.
example_uz: Shahar eski port hududini qayta rivojlantirishni rejalashtirmoqda.

definition_en: Not fully developed, especially economically.
example_en: Investment is needed in underdeveloped regions.
example_uz: Rivojlanmagan hududlarga investitsiya kerak.

definition_en: Developed too much, often losing natural qualities.
example_en: Critics say the coastline has become overdeveloped.
example_uz: Tanqidchilar sohil chizig'i ortiqcha rivojlanganini aytishmoqda.

definition_en: Suggesting something, often something not stated directly.
example_en: Her tone was suggestive of hidden disappointment.
example_uz: Uning ohangi yashirin ko'ngilsizlikka ishora qilardi.

definition_en: Thinking deeply and carefully about something.
example_en: She fell into a reflective silence after the news.
example_uz: Xabardan keyin u mulohazali sukutga cho'mdi.

definition_en: Not officially placed in a secret or restricted category.
example_en: The report was unclassified and available to the public.
example_uz: Hisobot tasniflanmagan va omma uchun ochiq edi.

definition_en: Impossible to find an answer or solution to.
example_en: The puzzle seemed unsolvable at first.
example_uz: Boshida jumboq yechilmaydigandek tuyuldi.

definition_en: Able to be solved or answered.
example_en: With more data, the problem becomes solvable.
example_uz: Ko'proq ma'lumot bilan muammoni yechish mumkin bo'ladi.

definition_en: The quality of not paying enough attention to what you do.
example_en: The accident happened because of carelessness.
example_uz: Baxtsiz hodisa beparvolik tufayli sodir bo'ldi.

definition_en: The quality of being useful or helpful.
example_en: The tool's usefulness depends on how well it's maintained.
example_uz: Asbobning foydaliligi u qanchalik yaxshi parvarish qilinishiga bog'liq.

definition_en: In a way that has no use or effect.
example_en: He waved his arms uselessly, unable to help.
example_uz: U yordam bera olmasdan qo'llarini foydasiz ravishda silkitardi.

definition_en: Concerned with examining and finding out facts.
example_en: She works as an investigative journalist.
example_uz: U tergovchi jurnalist bo'lib ishlaydi.

definition_en: To make someone lose enthusiasm for doing something.
example_en: Constant criticism can demotivate employees quickly.
example_uz: Doimiy tanqid xodimlarning rag'batini tez yo'qotishi mumkin.

definition_en: Having lost enthusiasm or willingness to work.
example_en: The team felt demotivated after losing the contract.
example_uz: Shartnomani yo'qotgach jamoa rag'bati yo'qolganini his qildi.

definition_en: Lacking the desire or drive to do something.
example_en: An unmotivated student rarely finishes assignments on time.
example_uz: Rag'batsiz talaba topshiriqlarni kamdan-kam o'z vaqtida bajaradi.

definition_en: Not pleased or content with something.
example_en: He remained unsatisfied with the final result.
example_uz: U yakuniy natijadan qanoat hosil qilmadi.
